race.title: Olly Murphy Proudly Sponsored By Betano 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 2)
race.verdict: Plenty of similarities to the first division with race sponsor Olly Murphy again mob-handed, CROOKHAVEN getting the vote to make a winning start under Rules having easily won an Irish point back in the spring. Stablemate Burk Flight has a French jumps pedigree, so he looks an obvious threat with attentions quickly switched to hurdles, with Smile John Boy , Roximan and Bebe And Bean just a handful of others worth considering, too. CROOKHAVEN BURK FLIGHT (FR) SMILE JOHN BOY (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Smile John Boy (5/2), Rock On Ronnie (3/1), Crookhaven (4/1), Half Hoping (7/1), Roximan (7/1), Bebe And Bean (12/1), Burk Flight (14/1), Pixie Dust (20/1), Peterman (20/1), Short Sell (50/1), Jim Santiago Bowie (66/1), T R Five (100/1), Wannabe Sporty (100/1), Wet Sail (100/1)
